work.title: C05 — Provider-switch calibration report (portability feature)
work.description: When a provider is added or removed, re-run a sample of historical ledger tasks on the new configuration and produce a calibration report with explicit uncertainty on small samples, flagging negative transfer of instructions/skills per task category.
work.acceptance_criteria: One calibration run on ≥20 sampled tasks produces a report the operator uses to set defaults; sample-size caveats shown; no automatic effort-level equivalence assumed. Optional; only after C04.
